_note: Typical screening values. The contract specification, the crane manufacturer's limits and the site health-and-safety plan always take precedence. Edit these to match them.

heat_wbgt_moderate_work_acclimatised_C._source: ACGIH TLV / ISO 7243 style screening, moderate work, acclimatised workers

crane._source: typical tower-crane in-service limits; gust scaled from 10 m to hook height by the 1/7 power law

concrete._source: ACI 305R evaporation-rate guidance (Uno 1998 formula); concrete assumed warmer than air by concrete_minus_air_C
concrete._cold_source: ACI 306R cold-weather concreting: protect below about 5 C; caution below 10 C

coatings._source: ISO 8502-4: surface at least 3 C above dew point; RH at most 85 %

lightning._source: convective screening: CAPE with rain probability, and forecast rain in the hour for 'likely'; Kampala CAPE is above 1000 J/kg most hours, so CAPE alone is not a signal. Stop exposed work at the first thunder (30-30 rule).

asphalt._source: typical hot-mix asphalt and bituminous surface-dressing practice (e.g. MoWT General Specifications for Roads and Bridges): no laying or spraying in rain or on a wet surface, nor when rain is imminent; thin lifts cool fast in wind

_working_note: 8-hour working day: 08:00-17:00 with a lunch break 13:00-14:00 (break hours are not counted)

dust._source: Open-Meteo/CAMS dust concentration; a dust event reduces visibility and needs eye protection and secured materials

seasonal_break._source: Qatar Ministerial Decision 17/2021: outdoor work banned 10:00-15:30, 1 June-15 September. Verify against the ministry's current decision before relying on it.

_legal_wbgt_source: Qatar Ministerial Decision 17/2021: all outdoor work stops when WBGT exceeds 32.1 C, any time of year. Verify against the current decision.
